! Game text
| Deploy on table. When deployed, shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top 3 cards, and {{Errata hl|1=place them face-down here. Once per battle, you may place one card here in your hand}} to prevent either player from drawing more than one battle destiny (battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled). (Immune to Alter.) || Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top three cards, and {{Errata hl|1=stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a stacked card into hand}} to prevent players from drawing more than one battle destiny (those battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled). (Immune to Alter.)
